edits.why: Tokens come from maude-v2. The v2 component sheet loads last, so the shared controls take the v2 look. The old sheet stays only as a bridge for .panel, .btn--icon and .callout, which v2 doesn't have.
The canvas header names its design system. It should match the meta.

notes: Every var(--…) token in this canvas also exists in maude-v2, so no token is renamed.
Classes that v2 doesn't have, used here: .panel (lines 89, 136, 177), .btn--icon (100, 146, 183), .callout/.callout--info (187).
The theme stays forced to dark (line 244).
The before/after thumbnails ring changes with --status-warn and --status-success. maude-v2 keeps those names, but its hues differ, so check them in the screenshot after you apply.
The prose in the header comment (line 11) and the comment in the sibling DiffView.css still name the maude DS. Both are text only.
